promotions.behavior: Central fail-closed trust-boundary and capability authorization
promotions.runtimeImpact: Prevents unregistered or under-privileged calls from reaching subsystem mutation owners.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: No character-save mutation is authorized without an explicit capability.
promotions.worldStateImpact: No world-state mutation is authorized without an explicit capability.

promotions.behavior: Canonical identifier, input-length and input-content validation
promotions.runtimeImpact: Reduces injection and malformed-input risk at subsystem boundaries.
promotions.characterSaveImpact: Malformed data cannot enter save mutation requests.
promotions.worldStateImpact: Malformed data cannot enter world-state mutation requests.
